outcome: Inability to perform artificial rupture of membranes
cohort: Women with a live singleton cephalic pregnancy induced after one previous birth by caesarean section
finding: The DBC and PGE2 appear to be equally effective for induction of labour in women with one previous caesarean section.
mod_finding: This study found no significant difference in vaginal birth rates between women induced with a double-balloon catheter and those induced with prostaglandin gel after one previous cesarean section.
